{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
deduplicated_data = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Correct assay_batch B values: divide by 10 to convert from µg/L to ng/mL
deduplicated_data['biomarker_final_corrected'] = deduplicated_data['biomarker_final']
deduplicated_data.loc[deduplicated_data['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final_corrected'] /= 10

# Compute the mean of biomarker_final_corrected across all patients
mean_biomarker_final = deduplicated_data['biomarker_final_corrected'].mean()

# Show a sample of batch A and batch B values to demonstrate the correction
batch_a_sample = deduplicated_data[deduplicated_data['assay_batch'] == 'A']['biomarker_final_corrected'].sample(5)
batch_b_sample = deduplicated_data[deduplicated_data['assay_batch'] == 'B']['biomarker_final_corrected'].sample(5)

print(f"Mean biomarker_final (corrected for assay_batch B) across all patients: {mean_biomarker_final}")
print(f"\nSample of batch A (should be in ng/mL):\n{batch_a_sample}")
print(f"\nSample of batch B (was in µg/L, now corrected to ng/mL):\n{batch_b_sample}")"}
